scope: Existing artifact inspection, one custom seen-state B0/F0 development pilot, offline T7-T10 writer diagnostics, and an offline MiniVLA source/checkpoint audit; no model training or official benchmark score
limitations: Episode JSONs and selected small manifests were read and hashed.
Only the four exported adapter files are independently rehashed here; large base weights, raw HDF5, shards and all videos are not rehashed.
Historical runs are inventoried, not pooled or declared comparable.
Stored test split has already been used for development; it is not a fresh confirmatory holdout.
T7 RGB index evidence, when present, is an offline writer artifact and has no independent relation labels.
T9 RGB index evidence is one author-refined training demonstration; it has no independent identity or containment labels.
MiniVLA checkpoint/source audit is provenance and interface evidence only; it includes no model inference or policy rollout.

signoff.notes: Internal derived baseline frozen for paired comparison against V2 memory models under identical host conditions. Strict official reproduction is not claimed.

frozen_v1.use: Historical reported result only; referenced raw episodes absent at inspection

derived_data.note: Summary metadata only; HDF5 contents, byte hashes and end-to-end readiness not certified

limitations: Three initial states only, no blind holdout
Successful demonstrations; failure-trajectory precision unmeasured
RGB relation estimates, not physical contact truth
About 1 second per live detector frame

matching.assignment: maximum-cardinality one-to-one, then maximum total IoU

limitations: Frames within one demonstration are temporally dependent; counts are descriptive, not independent samples.
Author exo-box labels are used as released and are not a second blind human annotation.
The third exo-box field is preserved as annotation metadata; this report does not interpret it as relation truth.
Detection quality does not establish identity tracking, relation accuracy, memory utility, or task success.

limitations: One author-source demonstration per task; no policy was run.

T8 raw/refined demo_1 actions and initial state match exactly; a pinned-runtime replay first exceeds the diagnostic 1e-5 robot-state tolerance at step 219 and still does not report terminal success. The cause remains unresolved; this is not a gate pass.
T9 and T10 each reported final upstream success on demo_1; this does not measure perception, memory, or policy competence.
This audit checks declared transform and code-path parity, not policy competence or causal explanation for E0 outcomes.
It does not establish the actual camera pixels observed during every saved policy query.
F0 is a no-memory adapter; this does not close F1, memory-writer, or matched-policy gates.
